verdict.rationale: First-party docs say every change to the Model is recorded in the Model's changelog under the user's name and can be undone. They also say every write is undoable, and agent or MCP clients sign in and act as a specific person, so even AI-made changes are attributed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of timestamps (the "when"), detail on what the changelog records per change, any version-level or point-in-time rollback beyond undo, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
